name: Date (Hokkaido, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Date city emblem in white: an outlined disc enclosing a cherry blossom above stylised waves.
history: Municipal flag of Date, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 May 1936.

features.role: Date city emblem — an outlined disc enclosing a cherry blossom above stylised waves
